scope: Apple Packet Tunnel / NE source audit; shipped SDK and App Store builds not verified

fields.zh: 连接时始终开启。写 false 不会关闭 VPN 或切换为仅代理端口模式；请在 App 中断开连接。
fields.en: Always enabled while connected. Setting false does not stop the VPN or switch to proxy ports only; disconnect in the app.

fields.zh: 支持 system、gvisor、mixed；未指定时默认 gVisor。iOS/macOS 实际启用 Include All Networks 时，System/Mixed 改为 gVisor；tvOS 不启用该选项。
fields.en: Accepts system, gvisor, and mixed; defaults to gVisor. Active Include All Networks on iOS/macOS changes System/Mixed to gVisor; tvOS does not enable that option.

fields.zh: 由 Clash 管理，填写 utun0 等名称不会指定系统网卡。
fields.en: Managed by Clash; names such as utun0 do not select a system interface.

fields.zh: 由 Clash 启动时统一设置，YAML 中的值不生效。
fields.en: Set by Clash at startup; the YAML value does not apply.

fields.zh: 由 Clash 管理，无需填写。
fields.en: Managed by Clash; leave it unset.

fields.zh: 不生效，Clash 不启用 GSO 分段卸载。
fields.en: No effect; Clash does not enable GSO segmentation offload.

fields.zh: 不生效，Clash 不启用 GSO 分段卸载。
fields.en: No effect; Clash does not enable GSO segmentation offload.

fields.zh: 固定关闭，无需填写。
fields.en: Always off; leave it unset.

fields.zh: 固定关闭，无需填写。
fields.en: Always off; leave it unset.

fields.zh: 运行时设为 false，系统路由仍由 Clash 设置；不影响正常接管流量。
fields.en: Set to false at runtime; Clash still configures system routes and captures traffic.

fields.zh: 运行时设为 false，Clash 自动管理出口网卡。
fields.en: Set to false at runtime; Clash manages the outbound interface automatically.

fields.zh: 没有为某个地址族指定 route-address 时，影响该地址族的默认路由拆分方式。与 Include All Networks 是不同设置。
fields.en: Affects default-route splitting for an address family without explicit route-address entries. Separate from Include All Networks.

fields.zh: 指定进入隧道的目标网段。还需结合客户端路由选项、IPv6 和系统 VPN 设置。
fields.en: Sets destination ranges to include in the tunnel. Client routing options, IPv6, and system VPN settings also apply.

fields.zh: 指定从隧道路由中排除的目标网段。还需结合客户端路由选项、IPv6 和系统 VPN 设置。
fields.en: Sets destination ranges to exclude from tunnel routes. Client routing options, IPv6, and system VPN settings also apply.

fields.zh: 配置可以读取，但不会把规则集转换为系统路由。普通 RULE-SET 分流仍可使用。
fields.en: Accepted, but rule sets are not converted into system routes. Ordinary RULE-SET routing remains available.

fields.zh: 配置可以读取，但不会把规则集转换为系统路由。普通 RULE-SET 分流仍可使用。
fields.en: Accepted, but rule sets are not converted into system routes. Ordinary RULE-SET routing remains available.

fields.zh: Linux 专用设置，在 Clash 的 Apple 版本中不生效。
fields.en: Linux-specific; has no effect in Clash on Apple platforms.

fields.zh: 由 Clash 统一设置为 0.0.0.0:53，接管进入隧道的 TCP/UDP 53 端口 DNS 请求。不解密 DoH/DoT。
fields.en: Managed by Clash as 0.0.0.0:53 for TCP/UDP port-53 DNS requests entering the tunnel. Does not decrypt DoH/DoT.

fields.zh: 设置隧道 IPv6 地址。关闭 TUN IPv6 时不使用；自动/启用时保留填写的地址，未填则补默认地址。最终是否启用还取决于 IP Stack 设置和网络条件。
fields.en: Sets tunnel IPv6 addresses. Ignored when TUN IPv6 is disabled; automatic/enabled keeps supplied addresses or fills defaults. IP Stack settings and network conditions determine final activation.

fields.zh: UDP 会话状态超时，单位为秒；不影响 VPN 可以连接多久。
fields.en: UDP session-state timeout in seconds; does not limit how long the VPN can stay connected.

fields.zh: 配置可以读取，但更改它不会改变当前 NAT 行为。
fields.en: Accepted, but changing it does not change current NAT behavior.

fields.zh: 固定为 true，ICMP 应答在本地生成。请用实际访问验证代理连接，不要只看 ping。
fields.en: Always true, with local ICMP replies. Verify the proxy by accessing a destination, rather than relying on ping alone.

fields.zh: ICMP 状态超时，单位为秒；设置它不会开启远端 ICMP 转发。
fields.en: ICMP state timeout in seconds; does not enable remote ICMP forwarding.

fields.zh: 用于 TCP 回环地址处理；不用于排除网段或选择应用。
fields.en: Used for TCP loopback address handling; does not exclude networks or select apps.

fields.zh: 不生效，不能用它筛选来源网卡或指定出口网卡。
fields.en: No effect; cannot filter source interfaces or select an outbound interface.

fields.zh: 不生效，不能用它筛选来源网卡或指定出口网卡。
fields.en: No effect; cannot filter source interfaces or select an outbound interface.

fields.zh: 三端均不生效。macOS 按用户或进程分流请使用分流规则。
fields.en: No effect on any platform. Use routing rules for user/process routing on macOS.

fields.zh: 三端均不生效。macOS 按用户或进程分流请使用分流规则。

fields.zh: 不生效，不能按设备 MAC 地址筛选。
fields.en: No effect; cannot filter by device MAC address.

fields.en: Android-specific; no effect. iOS app identifiers cannot enable per-app filtering here.

fields.en: No effect; cannot exclude ports from tunnel capture.

fields.zh: 仍接受，与 route-address (IPv4) 合并后传给 Apple；新字段不会覆盖旧字段，避免重复填写。
fields.en: Still accepted and merged with route-address (IPv4) before passing to Apple. New fields do not replace legacy values; avoid duplicates.

fields.en: Still accepted and merged with route-exclude-address (IPv4) before passing to Apple. New fields do not replace legacy values; avoid duplicates.
